WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT year(service_date) AS yr, SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE year(service_date) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN trips END) - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN trips END))
        / SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN trips END), 1) AS trips_pct_change_2024_to_2025
FROM yearly
notes: Assumes trips come from trips_daily summed by calendar year (2024 and 2025 are both full years), and the percent change is (2025 − 2024) / 2024 × 100 rounded to 1 decimal.

WITH c AS (
  SELECT SUM(complaints) AS complaints
  FROM complaints_daily
  WHERE year(opened_date) = 2024
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE year(service_date) = 2024
)
SELECT
  c.complaints AS complaints_2024,
  t.trips AS trips_2024,
  ROUND(1000.0 * c.complaints / t.trips, 1) AS complaint_rate_per_1000
FROM c, t;
notes: Assumes complaints are counted by opened_date and trips by service_date for calendar 2024 across all provider types and categories, with both totals aggregated separately before dividing.
